svg.title: Possible anaphylaxis recognition and immediate-action card
svg.desc: Working anaphylaxis action card. Any one severe breathing, throat, voice, collapse or pale-and-floppy-child sign can be enough, and a rash is not required. If the person is unresponsive and not breathing normally, including gasping or uncertain breathing, call Triple Zero, put them on a firm surface and start CPR; a helper follows the person's adrenaline plan. Otherwise keep them correctly positioned, give their adrenaline device exactly as their current plan or label shows, start a five-minute timer and call Triple Zero. If no device is available, call Triple Zero immediately, keep the correct position and watch breathing. If the call will not connect, keep care going, use Chapter 3 and do not leave the person merely to seek reception. No device mechanics are shown.
svg.text: ANAPHYLAXIS — ACT NOW
Adrenaline first. Call 000. Never stand or walk.
WARNING — WORKING CARDS; NOT DEVICE TRAINING
Subjective estimates: core source match 95%; new layout 60%.
These are not safety, treatment-success or survival probabilities.
Injection and nasal devices differ. Follow the person’s current
ASCIA plan, exact device instructions and 000. Allergy-clinical,
device, practical and stressed-reader review is outstanding.
ANY ONE SEVERE SIGN CAN BE ENOUGH
• difficult or noisy breathing
• swollen tongue
• throat swelling or tightness
• trouble talking or hoarse voice
• wheeze or sudden persistent cough
• persistent dizziness, collapse or loss of consciousness
• a young child becomes pale and floppy
• abdominal pain or vomiting after an insect sting
NO RASH? IT CAN STILL BE ANAPHYLAXIS
Other severe stomach symptoms need 000/current-plan advice.
UNRESPONSIVE AND NOT BREATHING NORMALLY?
Gasping or unsure counts. Call 000 and use a firm surface.
Start CPR now. A helper follows the person’s adrenaline plan.
POSITION NOW
Usually lay flat. Card 2 shows the position exceptions.
Never let the person stand or walk.
GIVE THEIR ADRENALINE DEVICE NOW
Use its own label or personal ASCIA plan.
Start a five-minute timer. Record the time.
CALL 000
A helper calls while the device is given.
If alone, give adrenaline first, then call.
No device? Call 000 now; use Card 3.
No contact? Keep caring; use Chapter 3. Don't leave just for signal.
WORKING DRAFT — exact plan, device instructions and 000 control
